tools.name: trademark_application_guide
tools.description:
Return per-jurisdiction trademark filing guidance (process, fee range, timeline,
Nice classification) for cross-border sellers. market: US/EU/UK/CN/JP.
product_category: optional, for Nice class suggestion.

tools.name: brand_conflict_screen
tools.description:
Screen a brand name for conflict/squatting risk. Returns a checklist of official
databases to search (in order) and a distinctiveness heuristic. This does NOT query
live trademark databases — it tells you what to check and how to judge results.

tools.name: ip_risk_assessment
tools.description:
Assess infringement risk across four dimensions (trademark/patent/copyright/design)
for a product category. Returns a risk matrix plus avoidance guidance.
